title: Oracle Cuts 21,000 Jobs and Admits AI Is the Reason
description:
Oracle just cut 21,000 jobs and actually admited why in an official filing. Headcount fell from 162k to 141k in one fiscal year, down 13% 😳 The trigger? A $300B compute deal with OpenAI that blew up costs, and part of the cuts are people replaced by AI tools. Big tech is pouring $600B into AI infra this year 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
